sentences.en: Gonzales offers a bike to all his employees in Europe.
sentences.zh: Gonzales 向他在欧洲的所有雇员提供自行车。

sentences.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.
sentences.zh: 这家公司的三分之二员工是工程师。

sentences.en: Management will have all employees vote at the upcoming meeting.
sentences.zh: 管理层将在即将举行的会议上让所有员工投票。

senses.zh: 雇员, 受雇者, 雇工
